cast.name: 德拉甘·米恰诺维奇 Dragan Mićanović

director.name: 扬·茨维特科维奇 Jan Cvitkovic

introduction: The story follows an alcoholic nicknamed Bako, who decides to seek treatment in a psychiatric hospital. There, he meets Medea, a drug addict, and Drago, a psychiatric patient interested in chess. When the strict chief physician organises his own version of the Olympic Games, the trio forms a team called Hotel Alcohol. After they fail in the competition, they decide to run away to the coast, but the real trouble ensues when they run out of meds, and so they take over a pharmacy, where they all experience their own enlightenment.
